prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in Fort Lauderdale FL for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” company for every rental home, but **Real Property Management United** looks like a strong first company to interview: it manages single-family homes in Fort Lauderdale and Broward County, offers full-service management, and has a local Fort Lauderdale office. Its site also describes owner reporting and maintenance support. [Website](https://www.unitedrpm.com/)

I’d compare it with **Luxury Property Care**, which lists tenant screening, leasing, maintenance, inspections, and owner payouts, and publishes a fee estimate of **8–10% of collected rent plus a one-month leasing fee**. Confirm those fees and terms directly, since they can vary by property. [Website](https://luxurypropertycare.com/ft-lauderdale-property-management-service/)

Before choosing, ask each company for its complete fee schedule, cancellation terms, maintenance approval limits, inspection frequency, vacancy/lease-up process, and references from owners of similar homes. Also check recent independent reviews—not just testimonials on the company’s own site.
